description: Fixed-grid time-step refinement of the E-29 initial datum in the Hou finite cylinder: one 65x128 grid, one final time T_1 = 0.002191729, and the three fixed time steps dt, dt/2, dt/4, compared at the final time with an independent solver-B elliptic cross-check
interpretation: This measures the temporal discretization error of the shipped Heun integrator on a single fixed uniform grid. It is not a reproduction of any published amplification value, not a singularity candidate, and not a proof.
coordinate_system: axisymmetric cylindrical half-plane (r,z), r in [0,1], z periodic with period 1
normalization_description: Hou finite-cylinder normalization: u1 = u^theta/r, omega1 = omega^theta/r, psi1 = psi^theta/r; the E-29 amplitude 12000 is part of the audited equation and is multiplied by amplitude_scale, which exists only so that reduced-amplitude smoke runs can reuse this schema

units.energy: dimensionless kinetic energy on the finite cylinder
